cause: The selector removed only completed units, treated blocked history as open, and fell back to the first lexical unit whenever none had ready or in-progress status; it also ignored the task's canonical unit_spec pointer.
prevention: Define an explicit runnable status matrix, prefer a runnable canonical unit_spec, skip blocked and terminal history, and fail closed with no claim command when no runnable unit exists; cover blocked-history plus new-planned-unit order in a producer-level regression.
summary: Canonical taskset planning selected the oldest blocked remediation unit instead of a newly registered planned unit and emitted a claim command for the frozen scope.
title: Blocked unit history must never be a dispatch fallback
